videos.caption: Some people think because you deliver food you have to go along with anything. They see the job first. They forget there is a person behind it. Back home in Morocco respect comes before any request. You do not cross lines just because you can pay for something. Here it can feel different. Some act like the uniform means they get to decide the rules. My work does not erase my limits. It does not change what feels wrong. And it does not give anyone the right to treat me like less than a person. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #moroccangirl #explore #dontjudge

Growing up the way I did I learned to keep things calm outside. People watch a Moroccan girl and expect no strong words ever. They see you speak up and think you left your manners behind. But facing what happens in the moment leaves your values untouched. It does not remove the way you were raised. My culture stays with me. So does the choice to be clear when it counts. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #dontjudge #culture #explore

Growing up with sisters you learn to watch out for each other. People expect a Moroccan girl to speak about family in a certain careful way. They hear something playful and they start to judge. Like it means you forgot your values. My sisters know who I am. They know where I come from. And they know the bond we share. You can keep that respect and still have moments that feel free. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #family #culture #explore
